suite: the map (Map . Classic, the counts, the one selection on four surfaces, the view)
expect_red: [real] in the DAG view the map takes the wider region, re-fitted, with its header still in the region

mutations.contract: A region that changes size under a fitted view is fitted again to its own width and height, up to the cap; the DAG view's wider region fits larger than Side by side's.
mutations.note: Caps every fit at 0.3: Side by side at the suite's 1700-wide window fits under that anyway (about 0.2), so every earlier check passes, and the DAG view's wider region can no longer fit larger -- the check compares the drawn zoom with the fit the region's own numbers ask for. Two earlier cuts (the resize observer alone; the fit to the height both ways) were NOT WITNESSED: the view switch repaints, and an overflowing first paint aborted the suite at a hover.
mutations.find: var k = Math.min(width / bounds.w, height / bounds.h, VA.MAP_ZOOM.fitMax);
mutations.replace: var k = Math.min(width / bounds.w, height / bounds.h, 0.3); /* mutated: capped under the DAG view's fit */
